failure_rules.missing_bar: listed, never imputed; >2% of window sessions for any symbol (1 session = 4.8%) -> BLOCKING data review before the run
failure_rules.structural_hard_fail: no run; FORWARD-OBSERVATION-INVALID (data-incomplete) unless fixed by §3.9 re-acquisition before any simulation
failure_rules.unscheduled_closure: window runs until 21 completed XNYS sessions; end date and earliest Stage F move accordingly
failure_rules.technical_crash: technical re-run per §14; both runs kept
failure_rules.corporate_action_mismatch: BLOCKING data review before the run

disclaimers: A one-month result does not demonstrate a long-term edge (holdout HAC p = 0.166, DAY-22 §1.10).
No outcome authorises real-money or live trading; that requires a separate explicit decision.
No criterion is derived from DAY-25 / DAY-25B or other historical results.
Any later strategy change is a new DERIVED experiment that can never be confirmed on these 21 sessions (§14).

anti_mutation.adoption_deadline: before 2026-11-05 16:15 ET and before any Stage F data exists
anti_mutation.content_pinning: adoption commit records LF-normalised SHA-256 of the adopted .md and .json; the run refuses on mismatch
anti_mutation.immutability: never edited after adoption; changes are new amendments, labelled DERIVED FROM PRIOR OBSERVATION if after any forward data
